en.name: Paperboy
en.ability: Each day, you may get a news story from the Storyteller. If you read it out publicly, that night you learn if it is true.

revisions.v1: Each day, you may get a news story from the Storyteller. If you read it out publicly, that night you learn if it is true.

en.otherNightReminder: If the Paperboy read out their news today, wake them. Nod if it is true, shake your head if not.

zh.name: 送报童
zh.ability: 每个白天，你可以从说书人处获取一条新闻，如果你公开宣读了该新闻，当晚你会得知它是否为事实。

revisions.v1: 每个白天，你可以从说书人处获取一条新闻，如果你公开宣读了该新闻，当晚你会得知它是否为事实。

zh.otherNightReminder: 如果他在白天宣读了新闻，唤醒他并告知他是否为事实。
